title: The election was the match, not the fuel

scenes.narration: [confident] Chip stocks just had the second-worst day in their history: [emphasis] twelve point two five percent.
scenes.imagePrompt: a vast black glass trading desk covered in neat rows of gold microchips, one section of the rows tilting sharply downward like a wave, Wall Street windows at dusk behind
scenes.motionPrompt: fast push-in, then the tilted rows ripple downward

scenes.narration: Everyone blamed the election. But the election only lit the match. It was not the fuel.
scenes.imagePrompt: a single struck match glowing warm gold, held above a tall neat stack of polished gold bars on black marble, only the match is lit
scenes.motionPrompt: slow push-in on the match flame, the gold stack catching its glow

scenes.narration: Look at AMD. Data-center revenue up [emphasis] ninety-seven percent. The stock fell seventeen percent.
scenes.imagePrompt: a gleaming gold microchip rising on a glowing gold column while a glass elevator beside it drops smoothly down a black atrium
scenes.motionPrompt: camera tracks the elevator down while the chip keeps rising

scenes.narration: When results like that cannot hold a stock up, the market is repricing who owns it.
scenes.motionPrompt: slow lateral drift across the trading floor

scenes.narration: The biggest drop was memory. Sandisk fell [emphasis] twenty-two percent. Micron, seventeen.
scenes.imagePrompt: long rows of gold memory modules standing on black velvet, the front row tipping forward like dominoes mid-fall, warm gold rim light
scenes.motionPrompt: low dolly along the rows as the dominoes tip

scenes.narration: Memory prices are now squeezing their own customers. Apple guided its margin down to [emphasis] forty-five percent.
scenes.imagePrompt: a brass balance scale on a black marble desk, a heavy stack of gold memory chips on one pan outweighing a sleek dark smartphone on the other
scenes.motionPrompt: slow push-in as the scale settles toward the chips

scenes.narration: On Friday, AMD bounced [emphasis] eight percent and Nvidia six. Memory fell again.
scenes.imagePrompt: a polished gold spring bouncing upward off a black marble floor, beside it a gold memory module sliding steadily down a glass ramp
scenes.motionPrompt: the spring leaps up through frame while the module keeps sliding

scenes.narration: In a crowded trade, a ten-stock AI basket can carry [emphasis] fifty-seven percent more risk than the calm-day model shows.
scenes.imagePrompt: ten different gold objects, a microchip, a turbine, a small car, a coin, a server, hanging from one single gold thread and swinging together in unison against a black background
scenes.motionPrompt: slow orbit as the objects swing as one

scenes.narration: The takeaway: the AI trade is splitting into different businesses, with different cycles.
scenes.imagePrompt: aerial view of a single river of molten gold light splitting cleanly into three separate streams across black stone, calm and precise
scenes.motionPrompt: crane up and out as the three streams separate

scenes.narration: The full breakdown, by Niraj Neupane, is at the link in bio.
scenes.motionPrompt: slow tilt up to the skyline
